title: Experiment 8 – Checksum Error Detection
description: Implementation of Internet Checksum algorithm using 8-bit one's complement arithmetic and end-around carry.
aim: To write a C program to implement Checksum error detection using one's complement addition.
theory: The checksum algorithm partitions data into equal k-bit words and sums them using one's complement arithmetic with end-around carry. The sender transmits the bitwise complement as the checksum. The receiver sums data words plus checksum; a total equal to all 1s confirms error-free transmission.
algorithm: Read number of 8-bit data words and their binary representations.
Accumulate one's complement sum with end-around carry for any overflow past 255.
Compute checksum as bitwise NOT of final accumulated sum.
At receiver, sum all received data words plus received checksum.
If receiver sum equals 255 (all 1s), report no error; otherwise report error detected.
